name: Boulder Woods Campground
note: Mostly seasonal: about 37 of its roughly 190 numbered sites are kept for nightly RV campers on the operator's 2025 map, the rest leased by the season. Reservations go through a request form or a phone call, with no instant online booking. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator rates page (boulderwoods.com/boulder-woods-camping-rates, WP-modified 2025-10-13, read 2026-10-21): RV Sites (Electric & Water) Daily $55 / Weekly $330 with no minimum stated (tent sites alone carry '2 Day (Min)'), seasonal sites 'Call Store', phone 215-257-7178 and a reservation request form; operator site map 'Map-Trifold-20250423' color-codes ~37 'RV Sites (Elec. & Water)' (Ash 0/00/8/9, Oak 10/15/17, Hickory 14-23, Dogwood 11-18, Elm 1-13 odd, Pine P1-P5) against ~150 'Seasonal Sites' (~20% sold by the night, over 1 in 10); no homes or lots sold, no application; Google Maps 2026-10-21: open, 4.4 from 381 reviews, phone, pin at 40.3771,-75.4112 -> real transient RV campground passing long-stay tests 2-5; price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-21: the only water is the campground's small private fishing pond (lake rules: no swimming, no boating, catch-and-release), reached by a 'Path to Lake' that leaves the Elm loop on the operator's 2025 map, with no sites drawn at it. Esri World_Imagery read at 40.3760,-75.4080 (250 m half-width, rendered) puts the pond ~245 m east of the nearest trailers on the site loops, through unbroken forest; no pad has a sightline or an apron to it. No dam/berm question arises. -> not waterfront.
fees_source: https://boulderwoods.com/boulder-woods-camping-rates (WP-modified 2025-10-13, read 2026-10-21): RV Sites (Electric & Water) Daily $55.00, Weekly $330.00; Holiday Weekend RV sites 2 Day $130.00 / 3 Day $195.00; site fee covers one unit, 2 adults and their children; no resort or grounds fee (visitor $5-$12 and 'Check in prior to noon $10' are optional). Rates 'subject to change'; not a booking-engine quote.
booking_source: https://boulderwoods.com/boulder-woods-camping-rates (read 2026-10-21): holiday weekends (Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, two Halloween weekends) are sold only as 2- or 3-day RV packages; the ordinary RV rate is per day with no minimum stated, unlike the tent rows' '2 Day (Min)'.
flags: Single weeknight is read from the rates page (RV Daily $55, no minimum stated, while tent rows say '2 Day (Min)'); there is no booking engine to test it, since reservations are by request form or phone.

Nightly share counted by hand from the operator's 2025-04-23 site map legend (white = RV Elec & Water, tan = seasonal): ~37 of ~190, about 20%; counts approximate. RV Life says 100 sites, Campendium 208.

No maximum RV length is published. The form asks rig length and slides; Campendium's longest reported rig is a 29-ft travel trailer (2021); one recent reviewer said staff first offered a site their rig would not fit. Wooded, gravel sites.
Season April 1-October 31 (operator rates and rules pages). No sewer hookups; 4 free dump stations.
The PA Turnpike Northeast Extension (I-476) runs ~300-400 m east of the loops; reviewers mention road noise.
Pinned at the Dogwood loop/pool area (beside the Google pin), since the nightly sites are scattered across five loops; RV Life's pin is ~50 m off.
